messages:
Lena Ortiz: Hi team, first day! My kit arrived but a couple of issues: the dock powers my laptop but the external monitor stays on 'No Signal' when connected via the dock's DP. If I plug the monitor straight into the laptop USB-C it works. Also the wired keyboard on the dock keeps dropping for ~10s every few minutes. Finally, during onboarding I never saw the corp-wifi cert prompt and VPN fails with 'user certificate missing'. Should I open a ticket or try anything first?

Marco (IT): Welcome @Lena :wave: Quick checks: 1) try swapping the DP cable and try the other DP output on the dock; 2) power-cycle the dock (unplug power for 15s); 3) try the keyboard in the rear USB-A. For the cert, did you run the onboarding installer at https://onboard.redwood.example? If not, run it and watch for a cert prompt. Tell me your laptop model and OS.

Lena Ortiz: Laptop is Lenovo Yoga 9i (Windows 11). I swapped DP ports and cable, power-cycled the dock, still no image from the dock (only laptop direct works). Keyboard disconnects even on rear port. I ran the onboarding page; it finished but I didn't notice any cert prompt. VPN error is exactly: "AUTH: user certificate not found (lena.ortiz)".

Marco (IT): Thanks. Next steps: 1) open Device Manager > Display adapters and USB controllers and screenshot any warnings; 2) run "pnputil /enum-devices" in PowerShell and paste the lines for the dock if present; 3) try a firmware probe: https://dock-fw.redwood.example/diagnose and run the Windows agent (no install). If any of that fails, I'll file a ticket for a replacement dock. I'll open a ticket now so we can keep this tracked.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2610 created by Marco (IT) for Lena Ortiz  "Dock DP passthrough no signal; intermittent USB-A keyboard disconnects; user cert not provisioning". Priority: P2. ETA triage: 2 hours.

Logistics Bot: Shipment check: spare dock available in SF warehouse. If IT approves replacement, carrier can ship next business day.

Sophie (People Ops): Welcome Lena :tada: sorry for the rough start. If replacements or a loaner would help with meetings today we can expedite a loaner headset/keyboard. DM me if you need a coworking stipend while gear ships.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks everyone. I ran the firmware probe and it returned "dock model: RW-DK4, firmware: 1.0.3, passthrough status: error 0x14". Device Manager shows no warnings but USB devices section shows the keyboard briefly vanish when it disconnects. Happy to join a remote session this afternoon.

Marco (IT): Good info. I'll schedule a quick remote session in ~15 mins to pull logs and push a firmware rollback/patch. If the firmware patch doesn't fix passthrough we'll mark IT-2610 for a replacement dock and ship from SF next day. Leaving this thread open and we'll post updates. :thumbsup:"
